register_env_config: register an EnvConfig with a name and class into the ENVS_REGISTRY
get_env_config: get a registered EnvConfig by its name from the ENVS_REGISTRY
register_reward_fn: register a reward function callable into the REWARDS_REGISTRY by name
build_env: build an Env instance from a registered config name with runtime kwargs
build_env_overrides: build an Env using RLTaskConfig init_args overrides merged with runtime kwargs
